title: opsinjs documentation page frontmatter
description: The machine-readable form of the frontmatter contract enforced by apps/www/source.config.ts. Where the two disagree, source.config.ts is what the build runs.

title.description: H1 and the page's name in the sidebar, search and llms.txt. A noun phrase, not a sentence.

description.description: One sentence, written for the reader who has not opened the page yet. Used as the search snippet, the card subtitle in <ComponentsList>, and the OG description.

icon.description: A lucide icon name. Requires the loader's icon handler in lib/source.ts. lucide is the only icon library in the tree.

full.description: Render full-width without the table of contents. Used by generated reference pages.

status.description: Release phase. Drives <StatusBadge> and the section gating in <PageTemplate>: a section required at the declared status must be present or the build fails.

kind.description: Fully determines the page's headings. Pick the template that matches.

since.description: The version that introduced this. Use "unreleased" while nothing has shipped.

category.description: Catalogue category. A category beginning with 'health-' makes the Clinical meaning section and the governedBy field mandatory.

aliases.description: Search synonyms — what a reader or an agent would actually type. Indexed by fumadocs, emitted into llms.txt and /r/index.json. Globally unique across the corpus; the namespace is declared once in registry/catalogue.ts.

reviewed.description: ISO date of the last review. Mandatory on kind: health.

reviewer.description: The discipline that signed the last review. Printed by <Reviewed>.

reviewEvery.description: Freshness SLA. check-freshness.mts reports expiry; it does not fail the build.

a11yDate.description: Date of the last accessibility review, printed in the page header.

implements.description: Doctrine page → the catalogue ids that implement this rule. Every entry must be a real catalogue id, shipped or considered; assert-ia enforces the reverse direction too.

governedBy.description: Component page → the doctrine pages that govern it. Mandatory when category starts with 'health-'.

usedIn.description: Component → the recipes and screens that use it. The reverse index; assert-ia checks both directions.

evidence.description: Mandatory on kind: health. 'cited' requires a real, checkable source. Never invent a citation, statistic, DOI or date — an honest 'opinion' is always the better answer.
